messages:
lina: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp is getting hammered by client prefetch. Repro: user does rapid page scroll, SDK prefetch kicks in + windowing, we hit soft 429s and then a retry loop that keeps growing inflight.

devin: seen this. Is it the prefetch concurrency cap not honoring per-user tokens?

lina: looks like our leaky permit > prefetch window mismatch. code:

```js
// simplified
for await (const page of paginator) {
  prefetch(queue, page.nextCursor)
}

function prefetch(q, cursor) {
  while (q.inflight < PREFETCH_WINDOW) {
    q.enqueue(fetch(cursor))
  }
}
```

sam_k: hmm, two issues: 1) token refresh race (auth header transient) 2) backoff jitter not applied when code retries immediately after soft429

aziz: +1. We saw similar in dedicated tests when burst=10x. Suggest clamp PREFETCH_WINDOW per user and add token-queueing. Also add circuit breaker on soft429 per-route.

lina: added a quick patch to sampleapp to gate prefetch with an async semaphore. pushing diff: https://example.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/342

ci-bot: build passed — e2e flaky for pagination: test_paginator_race noted 2 failures

devin: can we add SDK parity note? py/js behave differently: py uses semaphore by default, js doesn't.

lina: yeah, need to update JS SDK default: set prefetchWindow=1 for unauthenticated demos. Also update docs and quickstart.

olivia: filing a small DX task: DEVEX-902 update sampleapp + docs + release note. I'll own the docs.

sam_k: also add metric: "client.prefetch.inflight_max" and alert for > threshold

lina: thanks. Plan: roll patch to sampleapp, then propose SDK default change, then include a note in onboarding quickstart about token refresh + prefetch. Any objections?

aziz: no objections. :thumbsup:

devin: no objections.

lina: ok rolling now — will post post-rollout notes

ci-bot: deploy started: canary -> staged -> prod

lina: update: canary looks good, soft429 rate down 80% in 5m window

olivia: added docs PR: https://example.com/redwood/docs/pull/58

sam_k: adding metrics dashboard

lina: thanks all — closing thread once docs merged
